item.description:
Key-encryption keys can sit in an HSM outside Azure, so availability and access to that external HSM become part of the incident-response plan for every service encrypted with them.

Azure · Where you adopt it, add the external HSM to monitoring and to the recovery runbook; losing it makes the protected data unreadable.
